name: SpatialQuickSortCollider
description:
Collider using quicksort along axes at each step, using Aabb bounds. 

 Its performance is lower than that of InsertionSortCollider (see `Colliders' performance <https://yade-dem.org/wiki/Colliders_performace>`_), but the algorithm is simple enought to make it good for checking other collider's...
